modelReview.summary: The manuscript fails to report the main results, lacks a clear study question, provides no variable definitions, omits model diagnostics, and does not address missing data. The results section is essentially empty, making the manuscript unfit for any inferential use. These are fundamental reporting and methodological deficiencies.

findings.title: Main effect estimates absent from manuscript results
findings.whyItMatters: Without reporting the hazard ratios, confidence intervals, and p-values, the study conveys no quantitative evidence. Readers cannot assess the magnitude, precision, or significance of the findings.
findings.actionableFix: Include a table of effect estimates (HR, 95% CI, p) for treatment, age, and severity from the Cox model, and reference them in the Results and Discussion.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check the Results section of manuscript.md; it currently contains only sample size, not the estimates present in stats-run.json.

findings.title: Study question not stated
findings.whyItMatters: Without a specific, prespecified research question, the analysis lacks direction and the appropriateness of the model cannot be evaluated.
findings.actionableFix: Clearly state the primary hypothesis or research question (e.g., 'Does treatment X affect survival time after adjusting for age and severity?') in the Introduction or Objectives section.
findings.deterministicVerification: Search manuscript.md for a declarative hypothesis; none is found.

findings.title: Variable definitions missing
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot interpret the analysis without knowing how survival_time, event, treatment, age, and severity were measured and coded.
findings.actionableFix: Define each variable (e.g., event=1 for death, 0 for censored; treatment coded as 0/1 for control/active) and describe their source and scaling.
findings.deterministicVerification: Manuscript says primary outcome, exposure, and covariates were not fully encoded. No definitions provided.

findings.title: Proportional hazards assumption not assessed or reported
findings.whyItMatters: A key assumption of the Cox model is that hazard ratios are constant over time. Violations invalidate the global HR estimates and may require alternative models.
findings.actionableFix: Perform Schoenfeld residual tests, log-log plots, or other PH diagnostics for each covariate. Report test results or graphical checks along with any remedial steps.
findings.deterministicVerification: diagnostics.json contains only test name and event count; no PH test statistic or p-values.

findings.title: No missing data analysis or cohort attrition description
findings.whyItMatters: A complete-case analysis of 240 records could introduce selection bias if missingness is related to outcome or exposure. The initial sample size and reasons for exclusion are unknown.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a flow chart of records excluded due to missing data, report missingness patterns, and consider sensitivity analyses (e.g., multiple imputation) if missingness is non-trivial.
findings.deterministicVerification: Manuscript mentions complete-case but not initial N or exclusion criteria.

findings.title: Statistical method ambiguous in manuscript
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript states the method was 'inferred from run artifacts' and needs confirmation, which is not a proper methodological statement. Clarity is essential for reproducibility.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly name the method (Cox proportional hazards regression) and provide the model specification (e.g., Surv(survival_time, event) ~ treatment + age + severity).
findings.deterministicVerification: Search manuscript.md for 'Cox'; no mention. The methods section uses passive, non-committal language.

findings.title: No survival curves or diagnostic plots
findings.whyItMatters: Figures such as Kaplan-Meier curves by treatment group aid interpretation and allow visual assessment of proportional hazards. Their absence is a missed opportunity for transparency.
findings.actionableFix: Generate and include a Kaplan-Meier plot stratified by treatment, with at-risk table, and a log-log survival plot or other PH check.
findings.deterministicVerification: figure-qa.json reports 0/0 figures passed; no images are included in the manuscript.

missingEvidence: Definitions of all variables (survival_time, event, treatment, age, severity)
Table of effect estimates (HR, 95% CI, p-value)
Cohort attrition flow and missing data analysis
Data source description and study design rationale
Model fit statistics (e.g., concordance, log-likelihood) if available
